Console ne dhoka diya toh diya... par Kissan Schezwan Spicy Chutney ki fiery heat kabhi dhoka nahi degi!
FilterCopy presents “Broke Bachelors Ka Gaming Mission” – a hilarious comedy about broke bachelors, gaming ambitions, and the chaos that unfolds when friends come together for one epic gaming session!
From making big gaming plans on a tight budget to arguing over who's the best player, blaming teammates for every loss, and getting way too competitive over a simple game – every gaming session turns into a mission of its own!
